{{Otheruses|River}}
'''Roaring River''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tasariq]]. The [[river]] was diverted to feed into a crater that was found to be rich in [[tasar crystal]]s to support a growing [[Mining/Legends|mining]] boom-town. Roaring River flowed into the crater via a waterfall. The particular acoustics meant that the waterfall could be heard from anywhere in the crater, giving that settlement its name of [[Roaring Crater]].<ref name="J15">{{JournalCite|15|Tasariq: The Crystal Planet}}</ref>
